summary: Implemented SHACL path parsing in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl.py. The 55 tests in test_shacl.py and test/test_path.py pass under the shared venv. Nothing is committed and no existing file was modified. Unverified: mypy, black, isort and ruff are not installed in the shared venv, so the type-check and formatting rules were checked by reading only (line lengths within 88, both files parse). Judgment calls: the non-node guard carries `# type: ignore[unreachable]` because the parameter is typed Node; the expected-exception ignore sits on the call line inside the `with pytest.raises` block rather than on the `with` line itself.
